'''Rock music''' was a form of [[Music/Legends|music]]. Enjoyed by [[Boo Rawl]], rock music songs tended to have anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] lyrics and were thus blacklisted by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]].
